{{Short description|Algebraic surface with 99 nodes}}
In mathematics, the '''Labs septic surface''' is a degree-7 ([[Septic equation|septic]]) [[nodal surface]] with 99 [[Singular point of an algebraic variety#Nodes|nodes]] found by {{harvtxt|Labs|2006}}. As of 2015, it has the largest known number of nodes of a degree-7 surface, though this number is still less than the best known upper bound of 104 nodes given by {{harvtxt|Varchenko|1983}}.<ref>The upper bound in degree 7 given by {{harvtxt|Giventalʹ|1983}} is 106.</ref>

[[File:3D model of Real points of the Labs septic.stl|thumb|3D model of affine chart of the real Labs septic]]
